 Miles Bridges struggles Wednesday 
 by Ari Koslow | Suns Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 2:53am EDT 
 Miles Bridges scored eight points (3-11 FG, 0-5 3PT, 2-2 FT) to go along with four rebounds, one steal and one block in the Suns 124-83 loss against the Trail Blazers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Bridges played 29 minutes in a blowout loss in his Suns debut. He'll look to bounce back on Saturday against the Warriors.
